name: ad/end-card
description: Static close: the brand lockup, one CTA pill and an optional legal line. Enters in 0.5 s along the brand current, then holds still. Reusable as the last shot of an ad or promo.

cta.doc: The one call to action, rendered as the accent pill.

headline.doc: Optional line above the CTA (the offer). Leave empty for a pure brand close.

url.doc: Short domain beside the CTA, optional.

legal.doc: Optional legal or disclaimer line, set small and muted at the bottom of the safe box.

logo.doc: lockup = the brand mark beside the brand name; name = the name alone (brands without a mark).
